newsitem.title: ITALY: Compart continues to rise in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Compart continues to rise in Milan.

text.p: Shares in Italian industrial holding group Compart, formerly known as Ferruzzi Finanziaria, continued to rise helped by technical buying, possible group disposals and merger talk with its sister company Montedison.
Dealers said that the stock was gaining from technical buying following its sharp fall when Compart shares fell out of the Mib30 index of top Italian stocks in September.

They also underlined talk that it may sell off its 31.8 percent stake in insurance group Fondiaria, while the planned telecoms merger between STET and Telecom Italia announced early this week encouraged renewed talk of a Compart/Montedison merger.
At 1530 GMT, Compart shares were up 5.54 percent at 625 lire while Montedison was up just 0.38 percent at 1,070 lire.

Compart has just over a 30 percent stake in Montedison and analysts have often speculated over a merger between the two group since they were both rescued from the edge of financial collapse in the early 1990s by a group of banks.
